summary: First end-to-end test of NBMT Trading Co. app. Backend: 28/28 pytest tests pass (100%) covering health, public updates/certificates/enquiries, admin auth gating on 10 endpoints, and authenticated admin CRUD on enquiries/updates/certificates via directly-inserted Mongo session token. Frontend: 23/24 Playwright checks pass across Home, Products (filtering), ProductDetail, Quote (validation + submit + URL prefill from ProductDetail), Contact (validation + submit), GlobalReach (map + region panel updates), Certificates (4+ cards + lightbox), Updates list + UpdateDetail, and Admin sign-in gate. The single frontend 'failure' is a test-data artifact only (URL ?product=Basmati Rice does not match any exact PRODUCTS entry in the <select>, so it stays blank) — real prefill flow from ProductDetail's enquiry button works correctly (screenshot verified '1121 Sella Basmati Rice' selected).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_admin: session expiry parsing OK, but datetime.fromisoformat on non-ISO strings would raise ValueError -> becomes 500 instead of 401. Consider try/except -> 401. Low priority since only trusted OAuth code paths write expires_at.
POST /api/enquiries has no rate limiting or captcha, so the public endpoint could be spammed. Consider adding basic throttling if this is a concern for production.
storage_key retry on 403 is good, but there is no locking around init_storage() global mutation — under concurrent requests two threads could both hit /init. Not blocking, but a race exists.

/api/files/{path:path} requires a DB record for the storage_path; images stored outside via `image_path` = full external URL are served directly from that URL which is fine. Frontend resolveImage handles both cases (verified inline in Home.jsx / Certificates).
Admin PUT/PATCH/DELETE endpoints do not validate the id format; unknown ids return 404 which is correct.

CORS is set to '*' with allow_credentials=True which is technically invalid per CORS spec (browsers will reject credentialed CORS with wildcard). For the /admin cookie flow, this could bite when frontend and backend are on different origins in production. Consider setting explicit origins.
test_credentials: Admin session was created directly in Mongo (users + user_sessions collections) using whitelisted email ktcmktg@gmail.com. Bearer token passed via Authorization header. No app-managed passwords.
seed_data_creation: Test-prefixed TEST_* enquiries were created and mostly deleted via API; a handful of TEST_ contact/quote enquiries remain in the enquiries collection (harmless, prefixed for easy identification).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_nbmt_api.py and use conftest.py which inserts a temporary admin user/session into Mongo (whitelisted email ktcmktg@gmail.com) and cleans it up after the session. Run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Frontend uses data-testid throughout (hero, hero-quote-btn, filter-{category}, product-card-{slug}, product-enquiry-btn, quote-form/quote-*, contact-form/contact-*, market-btn-{id}, market-panel, certificate-{id}, certificate-lightbox, admin-tab-{id}, google-signin-btn). Note the Quote page's product prefill reads the URL param exactly; use a real product name (e.g. `?product=1121%20Sella%20Basmati%20Rice`) or navigate via ProductDetail's enquiry button. Console 401 on /api/auth/me is expected for unauthenticated users (AuthContext bootstraps on load).
